splat_fused_env_map.review: 2026-10-19: SPLAT-FUSED HDRI env-map path (env_from_hdr_image). Four additions, none narrowing an absolute world coordinate: three narrow the accumulated HDR sky radiance (sums[ti*3..]*inv, a per-texel half-float range normalisation of the baked environment map) and one narrows the same clamped radiance scalar when the env texture is uploaded (*value * scale). All four operate on environment-map radiance and texture values, never on a camera, terrain or splat position; world positions continue to cross f64 -> f32 only through Anchor::to_render_f32. The base is the production inventory of d6b9e556, the commit this branch was rebased onto; the four env-map sites bridge it to 1865. The four sites were approved in the 2026-10-22 review (5617567760); the rebased base and result were confirmed by the world-coordinate gate at that head.
